描述_EN: this one stands on an ox, with a large bird raising its wings on the top of his head. modelled on the buddhist ‘heavenly kings’ (tian wang), these figures were originally used in pairs. tomb guardians were used to deter any evil spirits that tried to enter the tomb.
描述_ZN: 此人站在牛背上，头顶上有一只大鸟扬起翅膀。 仿照佛教中的 "天王"，这些人物最初是成对使用的。 守墓人是用来阻止任何试图进入坟墓的恶灵的。
